_comment: Guided tour of the native Burst Selection app (gui/native.py). Targets are keys the app records (button keys, spec attrs, window names); a target's "tab" (dock window key) brings that tab to the front. The Add and Run steps wait for the real press.

steps.title: The step everything else inherits
steps.text: This window decides what a burst is. BVA, 2CDE, MLE, H2MM and every FRET histogram downstream are one row per burst found here: change a setting on this page and every later number changes with it.

steps.title: The raw files
steps.text: Add TTTR files, a folder of them, or drop them on the window. They are read once here; nothing downstream re-opens them.

await.hint: Press Add files (or Add folder) and choose your measurements.

steps.title: The definition nothing downstream re-checks
steps.text:
The detector setup says which routing channel is donor and which acceptor, and which excitation period each belongs to.

Get it backwards and you still get a complete, plausible analysis, with E reflected about one half, and no fit statistic reports it. Set it against the hardware once and check it on a sample whose answer you know.

steps.title: Which search
steps.text: Every burst search comes from tttrlib's registry; its parameters are generated below the choice. The sliding window opens a burst where m consecutive photons fall inside a time T.

steps.title: Search permissively, cut afterwards
steps.text: Min photons drops short bursts after the search, whatever the search is. A size cut applied inside the search interacts with the threshold and removes dim molecules preferentially.

steps.title: The inter-photon cut
steps.text: Max dT keeps photons that follow the previous one within this time: the burst photons. Drag its line in the Inter-photon time plot or type a value.

steps.title: Search every photon
steps.text: The plots show a preview of the visible window. Run searches every photon of every file and writes the burst tables beside the files (or into a .pto).

steps.title: Check the selection
steps.text: The count-rate trace of the visible window: all photons, and the photons the search kept. Move the window under Display in Filter settings.

steps.title: Burst features
steps.text: Histogram any column of the burst table (the proximity ratio is computed from the green and red photons) and fit it with a Gaussian mixture.

steps.title: Hand the bursts on
steps.text: Save .bur writes one table, Export flrCIF the table with its metadata, and Open in ndX explores the run's burst folder.
